summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on 18 August 2026 announcing the repurchase and cancellation of its own ordinary shares as part of a buy-back program announced on 5 August 2026. On 18 August 2026, it purchased 2,630,014 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of 15.2637 GBP and 382,400 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$162.3308. Total consideration since program commencement was US$263.3 million for 12,748,014 shares. Shares were purchased for cancellation, reducing issued share capital. The buy-back is an on-market program, not a tender offer. Watch for ongoing daily repurchase announcements and total voting rights updates following HK share cancellations.
